capabilities: Translate selected text with one click and insert the result below it
Connect to multiple LLM providers and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint
Customize the system prompt controlling translation tone and style
Set the target output language per user preference
Test API connection and troubleshoot failures from settings
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; it can also be installed via BRAT. Documentation includes troubleshooting for API key, network, and endpoint issues.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in text translation, so translating selected text requires leaving the editor or an external tool.
